description: Defines internal data structures and constants related to address mapping and OMAP data used in breakpad's Windows symbol processing.

classes.name: OMAP
classes.description: Structure representing a mapping between relative virtual addresses.

classes.name: OmapData
classes.description: Contains OMAP tables and original image length.

classes.name: AddressRange
classes.description: Represents a range of addresses in an image.

classes.name: MappedRange
classes.description: Represents a range in the original image and its mapping in the transformed image.

classes.name: EndpointIndex
classes.description: Used for interval search indexing in mapping.

classes.name: ImageMap
classes.description: Contains a collection of mapped ranges and index for interval searches.

methods.name: AddressRange::Compare
methods.description: Compares two address ranges, considering overlap.
